verdict.rationale: FFmpeg ships its own official, versioned C libraries (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice) with versioned Doxygen API docs, so a developer can use it programmatically. The evidence shows only a C API, with no vendor-maintained bindings for other mainstream languages, and a community report says libav API documentation and examples are hard to find or outdated. missing for 10: official bindings for mainstream languages beyond C (e.g. Python/JS/Java), evidence of per-language versioning and maintenance, strong API documentation corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, official client libraries exist for mainstream languages, versioned and maintained by the vendor

citations.quote: libavformat implements streaming protocols, container formats and basic I/O access.
libavfilter provides means to alter decoded audio and video through a directed graph of connected filters.
